MINISTRY OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS — CIRCULARS LISTING (fixture for testing only)

General Circular: Relaxation of additional fees on filing of e-forms
Relates to: Companies Act, 2013, Section 137, Section 403
Form: AOC-4
Effective: as stated in the circular
Summary: Additional fee for late filing of Form AOC-4 is TEMPORARILY
RELAXED for filings made within 30 days of the original due date, per
this circular. Standard Rule 12 slab resumes thereafter.
